gamerule.cursed-spawners.spawner_action_: The probability of a spawner having an addition effect. Effects can stack. Spawners will not attempt to generate actions if this is zero.
gamerule.cursed-spawners.spawner_max_act: Spawners can have up to this many bonus actions.
gamerule.cursed-spawners.spawner_mimic_c: The base odds of a Spawner becoming a mimic when broken. Overridden by NBT data when applicable.
gamerule.cursed-spawners.spawner_mining_: Mining speed for spawners is multiplied by this value.
